description.en: PDF toolbox: extract text, metadata, and page ranges via pdfjs-dist (local, no API key).
description.zh: 本地解析 PDF，快速提取文本、元数据和指定页面内容，无需联网和 API key。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多源能力发现、排序与风险检查｜Multi-source capability discovery, ranking, and risk inspection for plugins, skills, MCP servers, and agents.
可以恢复归档的插件Archived-session recycle bin for DeepSeek Harness: list, preview and restore archived sessions昨天手滑归档了个会话花了几百万才捞出来，所以做了这个。

Generic dock-button host for a dsh (DeepSeek Harness) web client: renders one row of buttons above the composer and owns the dockButtons registry, overflow menu, i18n, and motion. Built as a Feature-Sliced Design static Cordis plugin.
Node SQLite persistence for DSH workflow templates and runs
Ponytail — the laziest-senior-dev skill set (skills + slash commands) ported to DeepSeek Harness. The best code is the code you never wrote.
Generic Companion-protocol bridge from DeepSeek Harness to phones/IoT/legacy agents.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Companion 桥：手机 / IoT / 旧世界薄 Agent。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness to macOS companion daemon (notify / Shortcuts / clipboard).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对接 macOS Companion（通知 / Shortcuts / 剪贴板）。

description.en: OpenCode GO quota widget pinned to the sidebar, with rolling/weekly/monthly usage bars, an elapsed-versus-remaining time bar under each, a same-origin usage proxy, an /opencode-go command, and the runtime x-opencode-session fix for GO gateway chat requests. Fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage.
description.zh: 常驻侧边栏的 OpenCode GO 套餐额度组件：滚动/周/月三条用量条、每条下方一条已流逝与剩余时间条、同源用量代理、/opencode-go 命令，以及针对 GO 网关聊天请求的运行时 x-opencode-session 修复。fork 自 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage。

description.en: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default).
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 白名单 SSH 接入 Unix/AIX/macOS（不走 shell；默认只读）。

description.en: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.
description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions、内置 OpenAPI 3.0 规范与在线调试页。它只 inject 宿主的 webServer 与 tools，挂在宿主 webserver（默认前缀 /api/v1）或独立端口，可选 API Key 鉴权，并自带一份教会 DSH 里 Agent 调用本 API 的 SKILL。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in two fixed report files at the workspace root.
description.zh: 注册 ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill 的 DSH 插件：面向编码代理的八条可核对工作准则（先查证再调用、有歧义先确认、业务规则给出处、先复用再新造、先测试再声称完成、按既有约定写、区分事实与推断、改动可回滚），外加第 9 条——用户每次提出需求或问题，都在工作区根的两份固定报告里成对记录诉求与改动。

description.en: Declares the OpenCode Go and Command Code route wire protocol and endpoint (so the API address never has to be typed), adds the DeepSeek V4.1 models to the OpenCode Go route and puts them first, completes the Command Code model list from its public catalog, and attaches a per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode requests (fixes 400 MissingSessionID).
description.zh: 为 opencode-go 与 Command Code 路由声明 wire 协议和 API 地址（不用手填地址）；把 DeepSeek V4.1 模型补进 opencode-go 路由并排到最前；从公开目录补齐 Command Code 的模型清单；并为发往 OpenCode 的请求附加按会话的 x-opencode-session 头（修 400 MissingSessionID）。
